messages:
anika: Quick thread — sketching an "elastic commitment" concept to bridge self-serve teams and mid-market customers. idea: commit to a monthly spend window but allow ±X% smoothing across a 30d rolling window to absorb spikes without punitive overage.
ben: Useful — can you outline the customer-facing tradeoffs? what do they get vs a standard commit?
lena: From sales POV, customers want predictability + some spike protection. this could replace small burst credits we keep adding. key Q: how big is X? 20%? 50%?
manuscript: typo — marco is name?
marco: i'm here — suggestion: three bands: conservative (±10%), flexible (±30%), premium (±60%). higher flexibility = higher unit price and longer minimum term.
anika: exactly. rollout criteria: we need pricing math, billing integration, and legal clause for retrospective smoothing. also must update console to show rollup usage across window.
ben: on pricing math: show an example. if MSR (monthly spend) = $50k, flexible(±30%) lets them use up to $65k without overage during month, else overage or auto-convert to next tier?
lena: sales prefers auto-burn from pre-paid credits for the first >X. but we need guardrails to avoid huge capacity hits. maybe auto-throttle at 2x peak until capacity confirmed.
manuscript: removed
marco: implementation concerns: serving runtime needs to expose a per-customer moving-average metric. engineering estimate: 2 sprints infra + 1 sprint billing & portal.
anika: launch criteria (MVP): 1) productized pricing table + API, 2) billing engine support for smoothing window, 3) console usage graph with rolling window, 4) clear legal T&Cs with clawback threshold.
ben: legal ask: clawback needs to be timeboxed e.g., if smoothing is abused repeatedly 3 months in a row, we require commit uplift or bill overage.
lena: also add a non-SLA low-latency guarantee for flexible band — we can't promise premium routing for everyone. must document feature gates.
anika: mock of customer-facing FAQ snippet: ```Q: What is elastic commitment? A: A monthly commitment with a rolling smoothing window to absorb short-term spikes. Flex bands control permitted variance and price.```
marco: backlog tickets I'd create: `PRIC-ELASTIC-1` billing model, `PRIC-ELASTIC-2` infra metric, `PRIC-ELASTIC-3` console UX, `PRIC-ELASTIC-4` legal T&Cs.
ben: sales ask: allow a one-time trial upgrade to a higher flexibility band for 30d post-signing. helps close deals.
lena: flagged: this may cannibalize burst credits — need migration path and sunset plan.
anika: next steps: ben + lena to validate with 3 pilot customers; marco to scope infra ETA; i'll draft pricing bands and legal stub by EOW. ping @pricing-bot to create tracking epic. :thumbsup:
pricing-bot: Created epic PRIC-ELASTIC (link: https://go/repo/PRIC-ELASTIC) - assigned to anika, marco, ben.
